بُرْقَانٌ Shining much in the body: (JK, K:) applied to man. (JK.) ＝
-A2- Locusts when they become yellow, and have variegated stripes or streaks: (JK:) or locusts that are variegated (K TA) with white and black: (TA:) [a coll. gen. n.:] n. un. with ة. (K.) ―
-b2- [See also بَرَقٌ of which it is a pl.]
From An Arabic-English Lexicon (Edward William Lane)
